failures.summary: Layer 1 status is 'fail': 9/9 install, 7/9 pass their own native health command. Repo-defect count is ZERO. Both non-zero results are environmental - one caused by the Layer 1 harness itself (l9-ci-debt-intelligence), one by a sandbox network restriction (l9-ci-sdk, health undetermined rather than failing). An earlier revision of this run wrongly recorded l9-ci-core as a repository defect; that finding is retracted and l9-ci-core passes. See the Layer 1 receipt's failures[] for the per-repo diagnosis and attribution.

Layer 2 status 'fail': 4 of 7 active seams PASS (core_to_sdk, sdk_to_assurance, harness_to_assurance, observability_contracts); 3 are partial with a blocked producer (resolver_to_intelligence - no GitHub credential; intelligence_to_lsp - publication gate fail-closed on a 0-finding corpus; pr_repair_standalone - GraphQL 403 on live review ingest). NO active seam failed, and no seam was forced with a hand-authored artifact.
Layer 3 has not run. All six live corridors are unproven.
9 of 15 fail-closed negative tests ran and passed; 6 were not run because their producer is blocked. None failed.

warnings: Layer 1 and Layer 4 made no repository mutation: no source edit, no commit, no push, no PR, no registry or schema change, no l9-pr-repair mutation enablement.
All nine repositories are checked out at their origin/main tips with clean git trees. Eight sit on branch claude/layer-4-activation-wb6bgf whose SHA is identical to origin/main.

Layer 1 environment caveat: the harness ran ensurepip into four repo-local gitignored .venv directories to repair pip-less venvs left by the session-deps hook. Removal was attempted and denied by the operator permission gate, so l9-ci-debt-intelligence, l9-ci-debt-lsp, l9-ci-debt-resolver and l9-ci-core still carry a harness-added pip tree under .venv. This is why l9-ci-debt-intelligence reports one failing test.
final_statement: DO NOT DEPLOY. Layer 1 has run and is informative but not passing; Layers 2 and 3 have not run at all, so every seam, every corridor and every fail-closed negative test remains unproven. The organism is unproven rather than proven-broken - only one of the three Layer 1 non-zero results is a repository defect (l9-ci-core mypy stub declarations).
